subject.title: [Security] Path traversal validation bypass in secret-file.ts with relative path injections

question: Can any supported non-operator surface, including an installed plugin or remote ACP/Gateway request, control the credential-file path passed into ACP startup?
rationale: Whether this is a vulnerability depends on the real authority boundary, not on the path string alone; only the security owners should confirm that boundary and disclosure route.

options.title: Trace privately first
options.body: Move detailed reproduction work to a private advisory and verify every caller before deciding whether a code change is necessary.

options.title: Harden confirmed boundary
options.body: If an untrusted caller is reachable, adopt the shared secret-file safety primitive and add focused traversal and symlink tests.

options.title: Document trusted input
options.body: If only a trusted operator can select the path, document that contract and close the report as not demonstrating a security bypass.

recommendation.title: Trace privately first
recommendation.body: Move detailed reproduction work to a private advisory and verify every caller before deciding whether a code change is necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior appears to originate in this person's ACP secret-handling commit, providing the strongest history signal for the boundary decision.
